text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I'm walking down the hall on a rainy<n>day, when...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I slip on a wet spot and stumble.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay, Big Brother?! Aaah... Of<n>course this
would happen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay, Big Sister?! Aaah... Of<n>course this
would happen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm the one who cleaned thehall today... so it's my fault you hadsuch a close call... Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm the one who cleaned thehall today... so it's my fault you hadsuch a close call... Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower's guilt weighs heavily<n>on her heart.
